description: The pie chart, titled "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)," illustrates the proportion of different token routing strategies used in a federated learning system. The chart is divided into three distinct segments, each representing a different routing method. The largest segment, colored green and labeled "LOCAL," dominates the chart, accounting for the majority of the distribution. A red segment labeled "LLM" represents 3.9% of the total, while a blue segment labeled "EDGE_P2P" accounts for 1.6%. The segments are arranged in a clockwise direction, with the "LOCAL" category occupying the largest portion of the pie, followed by "LLM," and then "EDGE_P2P." The chart visually emphasizes the significant predominance of the "LOCAL" routing strategy compared to the other two methods.
